defense_news.title: Pentagon awards Raytheon up to $20.7 billion to nearly double AMRAAM production
defense_news.summary: The Defense Department has awarded Raytheon a multiyear contract worth up to $20.7 billion to build Advanced Medium-Range Air-to-Air Missiles, or AMRAAMs.

defense_news.title: USS Klakring sent to the bottom of the Atlantic in joint US-UK SINKEX
defense_news.summary: A decommissioned U.S. guided-missile frigate was sent to the bottom of the Atlantic on Sept. 25 during a joint U.S.-U.K. naval exercise.

defense_news.title: Estonia blames Russia in arson attack on military robotics firm Milrem
defense_news.summary: Russian special services were behind the fire at a building used by an Estonian military robotics company last month, the government in Tallinn said.

defense_news.title: US forces exiting Iraq after 2 decades, leaving opening for Iran
defense_news.summary: U.S. forces are set to depart from their last bases in Iraq by Wednesday, a move celebrated as a victory by Iran and its allies.

geo_news.title: 33. Uluslararası Adana Altın Koza Film Festivali'nde "Sinema ve Toplumsal Hafıza" söyleşisi yapıldı
